# University of Houston

> > University of Houston's official website covering enrollment services, financial aid, academic programs, and student resources across multiple campuses.

The University of Houston (UH) serves students through its Enrollment Services Division, which includes the Office of Admissions, Office of Scholarships and Financial Aid, and University Registrar. The institution operates multiple campuses including the main campus, Sugar Land Campus, and Katy Campus, offering comprehensive support for undergraduate and graduate students.

## Key Topics

- Enrollment Services Division
- Office of Admissions
- Office of Scholarships and Financial Aid
- University Registrar
- FAFSA
- Tuition and fees
- Scholarships
- Student admissions
- Campus Solutions Services
- Sugar Land Campus
- Katy Campus
- Graduate programs
- Payment plans
- Student success and retention
- Honors College and special programs

## Financial Aid & Costs

- [Costs & Financial Aid](http://www.uh.edu/financial/index): Main financial aid hub with tuition costs, FAFSA, and scholarships info
- [Graduate Tuition & Fees](http://www.uh.edu/financial/graduate/tuition-fees): Graduate program tuition and fees information for UH students

## Enrollment Services

- [Enrollment Services Mission](http://www.uh.edu/about/offices/enrollment-services): Enrollment Services Division mission covering admissions and financial aid

## Academic Programs

- [Special Programs](http://www.uh.edu/academics/majors-minors/special-programs): Honors College, ROTC, Study Abroad, and dual-degree program offerings

## Optional

- [Helpful UH Links and Numbers](http://www.uh.edu/parents/resources/helpful-uh-links/index.php): Parent resource directory with UH contacts and myUH system links
